messages:
Ravi P.: Quick sync  need final decision on webinar hooks by today. Options: 1) engineering cost/latency tradeoffs, 2) customer embedding search case, 3) ops lightning (failover + rollouts). Pick two main + one lightning.
Lena M.: I vote 1 + 2. Ops as the lightning.
Chris D.: Agree, and add a prerecorded bench fallback. Last event the live demo lagged badly.
Ravi P.: Good call. Chris, can you record a 60-90s bench clip showing perf numbers and a short script? Drop in /greenroom/webinars/apr-infer.
Chris D.: On it. Will produce raw + edited by Thu 5pm PT.
Lena M.: Rehearsal windows: Wed 11am PT dry run, Thu 9am tech run, Fri 1pm dress. Everyone attend at least one.
greenroom-bot: Reminder: upload prerecorded fallback to /greenroom/webinars/apr-infer by Thu 17:00 PT. Auto captions enabled.
Ravi P.: Routing: webinar form should tag leads with `webinar_apr_infer` and route to AE queue B. Add a checkbox: "Interested in Dedicated". Lena, can you build the form + ad copy?
Lena M.: Yes  will draft two headlines and three ad descriptions for infra/search and PM cohorts. Also will prepare confirmation + reminder emails.
Ravi P.: Targets: 700 regs, 180 live, 30 SQLs in 14 days. Run-of-show draft: 00:00-03 intro, 03-12 deep-dive, 12-25 customer demo, 25-30 lightning ops, 30-40 Q&A/CTA.
Chris D.: Fallback rule: if stream errors >1.5% for 2+ minutes, switch to prerecorded and open chat-only Q&A. Ravi will be fallback host.
Ravi P.: Action items: Chris record clip (Thu 5pm), Lena build form + ads (Tue EOD), Ravi finalize invites and asset list. We'll confirm rehearsal attendance tomorrow. :thumbsup:
